verdict.rationale: Pipedrive is a CRM with built-in AI features, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Pipedrive's own MCP server, which exposes Pipedrive to external AI assistants. That is the opposite role and does not show Pipedrive connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Its 500+ app integrations and REST API are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
